items.title: Jensen Huang: AI data center push will create 1 million US jobs
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang highlights how scaling AI data centers is driving a major U.S. manufacturing revival alongside Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk. Huang outlines how expanding AI infrastructure will generate up to a million blue-collar jobs, asserting that the country is re-industrializing for the first time in 50 years.

items.title: What we know about Trump's meeting with Alex Karp, Jensen Huang, & other AI leaders
items.summary: President Trump met with several AI leaders at the White House on Tuesday, including Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang and Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei. Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul outlines the details.

items.title: 'This is a problem': The pope counters Jensen Huang on AI safety
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi reacts to Pope Leo XIV responding to Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang's stance on AI safety.

items.title: A closer look at Anthropic's 2025 losses, Dan Ives discusses AI safety risks
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes on the biggest stories as the trading day kicks off, weighing in on Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) leaked IPO prospectus and Advanced Micro Devices' (AMD) deal to acquire World Labs. Yorkville Ives partner and senior managing director Dan Ives sits down with Sozzi for a conversation about the latest developments and safety concerns emerging from the AI space.

items.title: Nvidia's $150B buyback could fuel next stock rally
Nvidia's answer to rogue AI changes the conversation
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang just made two huge moves that might change how we think about AI risk entirely. First, a new agent safety platform engineered to catch and quarantine rogue AI agents in milliseconds, then a record-shattering $235 billion stock buyback that speaks volumes about how confident Nvidia is in where this is all headed. In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down how this new two-part safety system actually works, why Huang's stance is the opposite of what other AI labs are saying, and what a recent state dinner guest list reveals about who's really steering the US-China AI race.
